svg.text: Vectors on the x-axis are stretched by 3, those on the line through (−1,1) by 2 — their directions survive, which makes them eigenvectors.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A vector like v is turned off its own line, so it is not an eigenvector; the stretch factor is what we call the eigenvalue.
